pages.title: Chromatography Column
pages.text: A mixture carried down a long packed tube: each part sticks to the packing for its own time, so they come out one after another.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the carrier flow and the column temperature. Too slow and the bands spread, too fast and they do not separate; the resolution Rs must reach 1.5. Hotter shortens how long each part sticks. A harder split needs more column: build it taller. Gases that come off it pure are assayed (the purity tag).

pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
